description: This is a test class for the WizardPageSwitchToKeyboardFragment, containing unit tests that verify the behavior of the fragment in different keyboard enablement states within the app's setup flow.

classes.name: WizardPageSwitchToKeyboardFragmentTest
classes.description: A test class extending RobolectricWizardFragmentTestCase to test the WizardPageSwitchToKeyboardFragment's behavior in different scenarios.

methods.name: createFragment
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of WizardPageSwitchToKeyboardFragment.

methods.name: testKeyboardNotEnabled
methods.description: Verifies that when the keyboard is not enabled, the fragment shows the 'off' switch icon and the icon is clickable.

methods.name: testKeyboardEnabledButNotDefault
methods.description: Checks that when the keyboard is enabled but not set as default, the switch icon remains off and clickable, and the click handlers are correctly assigned.

methods.name: testKeyboardEnabledAndDefault
methods.description: Ensures that when the keyboard is enabled and set as default, the switch icon shows 'on' and is not clickable.

methods.name: testClickedSkipped
methods.description: Simulates clicking the skip setup link and verifies that the app navigates to MainSettingsActivity.
